hero.lineOne: Notice your patterns. Find one small step.
hero.lineTwo: Reach real help when you need it.
hero.body: A private place to check in with yourself in under twenty seconds, try one small thing, and keep your own plan for hard moments close.
hero.limits: For students aged 18 and over. Not therapy, and not an emergency service.
hero.lumen: A soft cluster of light made of small dots.

one.title: Notice
one.body: A check-in is four taps: mood, sleep, energy, stress. Skip any of them, or all of them. After a few weeks you can see your own patterns in plain words, with no scores.

two.title: One small step
two.body: After a check-in, one short activity is offered: slow breathing, a grounding exercise, a ten-minute plan. Mark it as not helpful and it stops being suggested.
two.lumen: The light takes the shape of a seated person.

three.title: Real help
three.body: Your own safety plan and checked helplines stay one tap away, even offline. If you choose, someone you trust can get a short weekly note, or a message you decide to send.
three.lumen: Two people reaching toward a light between them.

items.a: A place to notice how you are doing, on your own terms.
items.b: Short self-help activities you can try or ignore.
items.c: Your own safety plan and a list of helplines, available offline.
items.d: Private by default. Nothing is shared unless you turn it on, and you can turn it off again.

items.b: An emergency service. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.
items.c: Monitored. Nobody reads what you enter, and nothing alerts anyone automatically.
items.d: A replacement for people. It is here to help you reach them.

helplines.title: Helplines you can call now
helplines.note: Each number shows the date a person last checked it.
helplines.empty: Checked helplines appear here once a person has verified each number. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
helplines.unavailable: The helpline list could not be loaded just now.

footer.lineTwo: It does not track you, score you or keep you scrolling.
footer.prototype: This is a prototype. Its clinical, legal and safety wording is still waiting for expert review.
